title: Additive Combinatorics: Cap Sets in F_3^n, 3-AP-Free (Salem–Spencer) & Sidon Sets
description: Pure Lean 4.36.0 (zero Mathlib) certified maximization across 14 classic additive combinatorics frontiers: 4 Cap Set tracks in F_3^4..F_3^7 (FunSearch Nature 2023 benchmark family), 5 Salem–Spencer 3-AP-free tracks in {0..N-1} (N = 64..300), and 5 Sidon (B_2) set tracks in {0..N-1} (N = 100..500). `AdditiveComb/Spec.lean` formally proves soundness of a carry-free 2-bit-per-trit SWAR line-completion verifier (`thirdPointBits`), a bitmask 3-AP checker, and a pairwise-difference Sidon verifier. Pinned to `google-deepmind/funsearch@cc53f27` (Apache-2.0).

tasks.title: Maximize Cap Set size in F_3^4 (baseline 16)
tasks.description: Submit a cap set in F_3^4 packed 2-bits-per-trit (00=0, 01=1, 10=2) in `AdditiveComb/CapF3_4.lean` (`AdditiveComb.score_capset_f3_4` and `AdditiveComb.set_capset_f3_4`), seeded with a constructive 16-cap (frontier: 20 (exact)). Frozen `AdditiveComb/BoundCapF3_4.lean` kernel-verifies valid trits, pairwise distinctness, and absence of any affine line x + y + z = 0 (mod 3) via carry-free SWAR `thirdPointBits` (`decide +kernel`).

tasks.title: Maximize 3-AP-free (Salem–Spencer) set in {0..63} (baseline 16)
tasks.description: Submit a strictly increasing 3-AP-free subset of {0, ..., 63} in `AdditiveComb/AP3_64.lean` (`AdditiveComb.score_ap3_n64` and `AdditiveComb.set_ap3_n64`), seeded with a constructive 16-element Stanley sequence (frontier: 20 (exact r_3(64))). Frozen `AdditiveComb/BoundAP3_64.lean` kernel-verifies strict ordering, range `< 64`, and absence of any arithmetic progression a + c = 2b (`decide +kernel`).
